article.content: Sydney teenager charged with offensive behaviour and sexual touching without consent in relation to incidents involving females aged 13 to 54 An ebike riding 13-year-old boy has been charged with multiple sexual offences allegedly committed against women on walking trails on Sydney’s northern beaches. New South Wales police said the boy was arrested on Saturday evening after a strike force was established to investigate inappropriate comments and alleged sexual touching incidents on walking trails in the Narrabeen area in the first weeks of October. article.aiArticle:
A **13-year-old boy** has been charged with multiple sexual offenses following a series of alleged incidents on Sydney's northern beaches trails. The teenager, who was riding an ebike, faces charges including offensive behavior and sexual touching without consent. The alleged victims range in age from **13 to 54**.

## Charges Laid After Police Investigation
New South Wales Police confirmed the charges in connection with incidents involving females in the northern beaches area. The investigation led to the arrest of the boy, whose identity has not been released due to his age. The use of ebikes in public spaces has become a growing point of discussion, with authorities often grappling with how to regulate their use, especially among younger riders.
